hero.title: Complex operational decisions,
hero.description: Digital Twin and AI-based Simulation built on real operational data — solving your organization's most complex decision-making challenges.

services.title: Core Capabilities
services.description: End-to-end simulation and digital twin engineering for complex operational systems.

items.title: Simulation Consulting
items.description: Discrete-event, agent-based, and system dynamics modeling across manufacturing, logistics, construction, defense, energy, and more. Powered by AnyLogic.

items.title: Digital Twin Development
items.description: Real-time 3D digital twin systems with live data integration, scenario analysis, and operational monitoring.

items.title: AI-Driven Analytics
items.description: Reinforcement learning-based agent policy optimization within AnyLogic simulation environments. Applied to scheduling, resource allocation, and operational decision benchmarking.

items.title: Corporate Training & Mentoring
items.description: From fundamentals to advanced modeling patterns, validation, and real-world project application — we offer tailored training and mentoring programs for teams that need a structured learning path.

items.title: Supply Chain Modeling
items.description: End-to-end logistics and supply chain simulation. Network optimization, risk analysis, and capacity planning.

items.title: Research Collaboration
items.description: Joint research with academic institutions and government bodies. Technical writing, methodology design, and simulation-backed validation.

approach.title: We understand the problem first. The technology comes second.
approach.description: We structure each client's industrial problem, then select or combine Digital Twin, Simulation, and AI — whichever approach fits best — to deliver an actionable decision-making solution.

steps.title: DEEP DIVE
steps.subtitle: We embed where the problem lives.
steps.description: We go deep into the client's operating environment to analyze processes and pinpoint exactly where data and decisions actually flow.

steps.title: DEFINE
steps.subtitle: We turn problems into engineering targets.
steps.description: We structure the issues found on-site into quantifiable goals and success criteria, and define the scope of the solution.

steps.title: TECH DESIGN
steps.subtitle: We design the right technology mix.
steps.description: We select or combine Digital Twin, Simulation, and AI — whichever fits the problem best — to design the solution architecture.

steps.title: CLOSE
steps.subtitle: We ship solutions that work in production.
steps.description: Not a demo — we take ownership through handoff of models and decision-ready evidence validated in the client's actual operating environment.

clients.title: Selected Clients
clients.description: Trusted by government agencies, large-scale engineering firms, and research institutions.

items.name: Logistics · Distribution · Supply Chain
items.description: Simulation and throughput optimization of logistics facilities equipped with conveyors, sorters, AS/RS, AGVs, sequence buffers, and other unmanned systems. Facility location selection, supply chain design, and logistics network optimization.

items.name: Manufacturing · Smart Factory
items.description: From manual assembly lines to fully automated facilities — extensive experience delivering simulation-based digital twin solutions across diverse manufacturing environments.

items.name: Government · Nuclear
items.description: High-reliability simulation modeling for nuclear facility operations, including material flow analysis and safeguards verification.

items.name: Construction · Engineering
items.description: Construction process simulation and resource optimization for large-scale infrastructure projects. Multi-face excavation and complex site environment simulation.

items.name: Defense · Security
items.description: Agent-based wargame and operational scenario evaluation models. Unit deployment optimization and simulation-based decision support for complex battlefield environments.

items.name: Energy · Environment
items.description: Energy facility operations optimization and LCA-based environmental impact simulation. Renewable energy system design and carbon reduction scenario analysis.

about.name: HyunHo Lee
about.bio_1: A simulation and digital twin specialist with over 10 years of field experience. PhD candidate in logistics at Incheon National University. Founding principal of DAS Lab, formerly operating as SimLab.
about.bio_2: Delivered 25+ commercial simulation projects, 100+ corporate training sessions, and ongoing research partnerships with government and industry.
specs: 10+ years of simulation consulting across logistics, ports, supply chain, manufacturing, nuclear, construction, rail, defense, and transportation sectors

contact.title: Start a Project
description_lines: Looking to model a complex system, build a digital twin, or train your team? Let's talk.

hero.title: Simulation Mastery
hero.description: A practical starter pack for learning AnyLogic and simulation modeling — curated materials, recommended books, and free resources you can use immediately.

learning.title: Learning Materials
learning.description: From fundamentals to applied modeling patterns — best places to start and keep improving.
learning.official_description: Core reference for modeling blocks, libraries, and built-in concepts. Use it to confirm "how it works" while building models.
learning.beginner_description: Beginner-friendly explanation of simulation concepts with examples. Great for learning the basics and building your first model.
learning.advanced_title: Building a Custom UI-Based Simulation Experiment Environment
learning.advanced_description: AnyLogic Private Cloud lets you deploy browser-based simulation experiment environments with no installation required. Parameter control, experiment execution, and result visualization — all in one interface, enabling field teams to run models directly.

books.title: Recommended Textbooks
books.description: Books that help you go beyond "tool usage" — modeling rigor, experimentation, and trustworthy results.
books.fundamentals_description: Learn the core vocabulary: entities, events, queues, resources, variability, and how to interpret results without overconfidence.
books.experiment_description: Focus on verification/validation, scenario design, sensitivity checks, and KPI governance so your model becomes decision-grade.

free.title: Free Resources
free.description: Quick links you can use today: models, libraries, community knowledge, and learning materials.
free.models_description: Browse ready-to-run examples to learn modeling structure, animation, and data collection.
free.community_description: Questions, troubleshooting, and implementation tips from other builders. Great for unblock and edge cases.
free.demo_title: Secondary Battery Electrode Manufacturing Process Simulation
free.demo_intro: A customized demo model based on AnyLogic's open-source Chocolate Production example, adapted to reflect the material flow and resource logic of a secondary battery electrode manufacturing process. You can run the model live in your browser using the embed below.
free.demo_cta_suffix: — including applicability assessment, scope definition, and model development — contact DAS Lab.
free.footnote: * This demo runs on AnyLogic Cloud servers. Based on the open-source Chocolate Production model by AnyLogic Company, modified and distributed by DAS Lab.
